maddeler.e:
نتطأمن (form IIq)
# نَتَطَأْمَنُ (nataṭaʔmanu) /na.ta.tˤaʔ.ma.nu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of تَطَأْمَنَ (taṭaʔmana)
# نَتَطَأْمَنَ (nataṭaʔmana) /na.ta.tˤaʔ.ma.na/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of تَطَأْمَنَ (taṭaʔmana)
# نَتَطَأْمَنْ (nataṭaʔman) /na.ta.tˤaʔ.man/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of تَطَأْمَنَ (taṭaʔmana)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
